attchmntText: Aastha Spintex Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Aastha Spintex Limited has published its standalone and consolidated un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The publication appeared in Financial Express all editions and Financial Express Gujarati edition on November 09, 2026. The company filed this notice with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to Regulation 30 and 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The filing serves to place the newspaper clippings on record with the exchanges.

attchmntText: Aastha Spintex Limited has informed the Exchange about Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up
desc: Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up
voiceSummary: Aastha Spintex Limited has completed the acquisition of one hundred percent equity share capital of Falcon Yarns Private Limited, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. The aggregate cash consideration paid was thirteen thousand one hundred fifty one lakhs rupees for three million nine hundred forty five thousand three hundred sixty equity shares. Falcon Yarns Private Limited is engaged in textile manufacturing and finishing, specifically hosiery combed cotton yarn and cotton products. It was incorporated on June thirtieth, twenty fifteen. The turnover for the financial year twenty twenty five to twenty six was twenty two thousand five hundred forty six point six five lakhs rupees. Additionally, the Board of Directors recommended the appointment of Mr. Shyamsunder Kiranbhai Panchal as an Independent Director on the Board of Falcon Yarns Private Limited during the meeting held on November seventh, twenty twenty six.

attchmntText: Aastha Spintex Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Demise of Mrs Jashwant Valjibhai Patel, Executive Director of the company on November 06, 2026.
voiceSummary: Aastha Spintex Limited intimates the demise of Mr. Jashwant Valjibhai Patel, Executive Director, on 6th November 2026. Consequently, Mr. Patel ceases to be the Executive Director with effect from 6th November 2026. The Board of Directors expresses deepest condolences to the bereaved family. This notice is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The intimation is submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The announcement is signed by Vivek Rasiklal Gothi, Whole Time Director, on November 7th, 2026.

attchmntText: Aastha Spintex Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Aastha Spintex Limited confirms there are no deviations or variations in the utilization of proceeds raised through its Initial Public Offer during the half year ended September 30, 2026. This statement was reviewed by the Audit Committee and taken on record by the Board at meetings held on November 07, 2026. The company filed this disclosure pursuant to Regulation 32 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The statement is signed by Whole Time Director Vivek Rasiklal Gothi, DIN 03149400.

attchmntText: Aastha Spintex Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Aastha Spintex Limited approved un-audited financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board took note of the limited review report by statutory auditors M/s S N D K & Associates LLP. The company completed the acquisition of 100% equity share capital of Falcon Yarns Private Limited for a cash consideration of 13,151 lakhs. Falcon Yarns Private Limited is now a wholly owned subsidiary. The Board recommended the appointment of Mr. Shyamsunder Kiranbhai Panchal as an Independent Director on the Board of Falcon Yarns Private Limited. The company also reported the demise of Executive Director Mr. Jashwant Valjibhai Patel on November 6, 2026. Consequently, he ceased to be the Executive Director with effect from November 6, 2026. The Board expressed condolences to the bereaved family.
